intelligence.human_view: The page becomes an app on the citizen's home screen — and the icon is the first thing they see every day. If the icon is generic, the app feels generic; if the icon is theirs — their face, their orb, their photo — the app feels like theirs. And the library is already built: the orbs, every colour known, the full library. Letting the citizen pick any of them for anything is using what we already have, not building something new — harvest, never invent. An orb with initials can stand for anyone or anything: a person, a business, a space, a thing. That is the whole system in one icon.
intelligence.simple_view: Imagine your page becomes a little app on your phone, like a tiny picture you tap to open your world! And YOU get to pick the picture — your face, or a shiny coloured ball with your letter on it, or any photo you love! And if you don't pick one, it just shows your page's name. Easy!
intelligence.grandma_view: It's like this, love — your page can sit on your phone like a little app, with a picture you choose yourself. It could be your photograph, or one of our pretty coloured balls with your initial on it — we have the whole collection, every colour — or any photo you fancy. And if you don't choose, dear, it just shows the name of your page. Simple as that.
intelligence.naya_view: Install the page as an app. Pick the icon: upload your own, your picture, our icon gallery, our orb library in every colour, or any photo. Default: an icon with the page's name.
